description: Canonical indicator dictionary for ManiPsych AdIntel. Every visible indicator has a canonical definition with formula, numerator, denominator, unit, valid range, thresholds, and limitations.

indicators.name: readability
indicators.plain: How clear and easy to understand the ad text is
indicators.formula: Flesch reading ease adapted for Spanish
indicators.correct: higher scores mean the ad uses simpler language
indicators.incorrect: does NOT measure manipulation — only text complexity
indicators.failure: very short text may score artificially high

indicators.name: urgency
indicators.plain: Time-pressure cues that push immediate action
indicators.correct: presence of 'urgente hoy' or 'solo por hoy'
indicators.incorrect: does NOT measure actual time pressure — only language cues
indicators.failure: paraphrased urgency ('actúa ahora') may be missed

indicators.name: manipulation_risk
indicators.plain: Composite heuristic of manipulation risk cues
indicators.correct: presence of 'ayuda económica a cambio' exchange framing
indicators.incorrect: NOT a probability of manipulation — only a heuristic cue count
indicators.failure: subtle manipulation without explicit exchange framing scored 0

indicators.name: silhouette
indicators.plain: How well an ad fits its assigned cluster vs the nearest alternative
indicators.formula: (b - a) / max(a, b) where a = mean intra-cluster distance, b = mean nearest-cluster distance
indicators.correct: negative silhouette means ad is closer to another cluster
indicators.incorrect: does NOT measure cluster quality — only per-ad fit
indicators.failure: corpus-wide silhouette 0.005 means clusters are weakly separated

indicators.name: cohens_h
indicators.incorrect: does NOT imply causation — only proportional difference
indicators.failure: small samples may show large h with wide CI

indicators.name: density_noise
indicators.plain: Whether an ad sits in a low-density region (no cluster of ≥10 ads within cosine distance 0.65)
indicators.formula: DBSCAN label == -1 (not assigned to any cluster)
indicators.threshold_provenance: Tuned for short Spanish classified ads
indicators.correct: true means the ad is in a sparse region of the TF-IDF space
indicators.incorrect: does NOT mean the ad is anomalous — only low local density
indicators.failure: 68% of corpus is noise — the corpus is lexically diverse

indicators.name: cluster_enriched
indicators.plain: Whether an ad is an outlier within its own cluster (MAD distance > 3.5σ)
indicators.threshold_provenance: Conventional outlier threshold (3σ adapted to MAD)
indicators.correct: true means the ad is unusually far from its cluster centroid
indicators.incorrect: does NOT mean the ad is globally anomalous — only within its cluster
indicators.failure: very small clusters may not have enough members for reliable MAD
indicators.worked_example: ad with rare vocabulary in cluster 0 → cluster_enriched=true

indicators.name: boundary
indicators.plain: Whether an ad is closer to another cluster than to its own (silhouette < 0)
indicators.correct: true means the ad is closer to another cluster's centroid
indicators.incorrect: does NOT mean the assignment is wrong — only weak
indicators.failure: with silhouette_mean=0.005, many ads are near the boundary

indicators.name: detector_outlier
indicators.plain: Whether an ad was flagged by the rule-based outlier detector (historical 11 kinds)
indicators.formula: any OutlierReport.kind matches for this record_id
indicators.numerator: count of OutlierReports for this ad
indicators.correct: true means a rule-based detector found something unusual
indicators.incorrect: does NOT mean the ad is malicious — only unusual
indicators.failure: only sampled 1000 of 5738 ads — may miss outliers in unsampled portion
indicators.worked_example: ad with structured 'Información clave' section → creative_novelty=true

indicators.name: wilson_ci
indicators.plain: 95% confidence interval for a binomial proportion (prevalence)
indicators.correct: the true prevalence lies in [lo, hi] with 95% probability
indicators.incorrect: does NOT mean the effect is significant — only the proportion range
indicators.failure: Wald interval (forbidden) fails at k=0 and k=n

indicators.name: q_value
indicators.plain: False discovery rate adjusted p-value for multiple testing
indicators.formula: p × n / rank, with monotonicity enforcement
indicators.correct: q<0.05 means the term is enriched after multiple-testing correction
indicators.incorrect: does NOT prove the effect is real — only controls false discovery rate
indicators.failure: Bonferroni (forbidden) is too conservative for exploratory analysis
